mapper.select: SELECT VENDOR_NAME, VENDOR_ITEM_NAME, VENDOR_PRICE FROM ITEM_INFO WHERE ITEM_NO = #{P_ITEM_NO} AND COMPANY_NAME = #{P_COMPANY_NAME}

SELECT IFNULL(CONVERT(AES_DECRYPT(UNHEX(LOGIN_ID), 'YUUM_SECURITY_KEY') USING UTF8), '') AS LOGIN_ID, IFNULL(CONVERT(AES_DECRYPT(UNHEX(LOGIN_SUB_ID), 'YUUM_SECURITY_KEY') USING UTF8), '') AS LOGIN_SUB_ID, IFNULL(CONVERT(AES_DECRYPT(UNHEX(LOGIN_PASSWORD), 'YUUM_SECURITY_KEY') USING UTF8), '') AS LOGIN_PASSWORD FROM SYSTEM_LOGIN_INFO WHERE USER_ID = #{P_USER_ID} AND SYSTEM_ID = #{P_SYSTEM_ID}
SELECT PRODUCT_ORDER_ID FROM ORDER_INFO WHERE RECEIVER_NAME = #{P_RECEIVER_NAME} AND SHIPPING_DT = #{P_SHIPPING_DT} AND RESULT = 'S'
